### Interface Declares Regular Quarterly Dividend


August 20, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/354928249/files/doc_news/Interface-Declares-Regular-Quarterly-Dividend-d20e5c802-2026.pdf)


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Interface, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.interface.com%2FUS%2Fen-US.html&esheet=54592766&newsitemid=20260820540021&lan=en-US&anchor=Interface%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=9ab389b928a9ee5a6213024164e6c55a) (Nasdaq: TILE), the global flooring and sustainability leader, today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.03 per share. The dividend is payable on September 18, 2026 to shareholders of record as of September 4, 2026.


**About Interface**


Interface is a global flooring and sustainability leader dedicated to rethinking how spaces work for people and the planet. Our portfolio includes Interface® carpet tile and LVT, nora® rubber flooring, and FLOR® premium area rugs. Across every brand, we innovate in a way that combines design, performance, and sustainability—without compromise.


Trusted by architects, designers, and building professionals worldwide, we help bring bold visions to life with solutions that deliver real, measurable impact. Building on more than 30 years of sustainability progress and industry-first innovation, we remain ‘all in’ on our goal of becoming carbon negative by 2040, without the use of offsets.


Learn more about Interface (NASDAQ: TILE) and our brands at[interface.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finterface.com%2F&esheet=54592766&newsitemid=20260820540021&lan=en-US&anchor=interface.com&index=2&md5=0a28d68f67d78ebdcb130984dd5ca029) and[FLOR.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fflor.com%2F&esheet=54592766&newsitemid=20260820540021&lan=en-US&anchor=FLOR.com&index=3&md5=cb6769af6c512622f3a70bfc6cbd23f5) .
